December 17, 2025 — Neal Dunn cares more about bailing out billionaires and appeasing his party than ensuring that 98,000 people in his district have health care come the new year. He refuses do anything to protect North Florida families from a 265% increase in health care costs, meaning the people who elected Dunn – the people he works for – will be getting a holiday gift of doubled or tripled health plan costs. Thousands in the district are sure to lose coverage completely, while others will be forced into high-deductible plans, with significantly less coverage.

January 13, 2026 — Thank you, Neal Dunn, for finally recognizing that another run for this seat would be a disservice to our commuity. After five terms of absentee leadership, we finally have an open seat and a real chance to move forward. Florida’s District 2 has been asking for more, and for better, for a long time: better communication, more presence, real accountability, and true representation.Today is proof that persistence and pressure work!To my neighbors in North Florida- our work is far from over. We deserve better, and I will demand better as your representative. With your support, we can fight for a better and stronger future for our families, together.

January 6, 2025 — Five years ago today, our democracy was tested when a violent mob attacked the U.S. Capitol in an attempt to overturn the will of the American people. January 6th was NOT a protest, it was an assault on our Constitution and a direct threat to the peaceful transfer of power. We honor the more than 140 law enforcement officers who defended the Capitol that day, some who were injured or lost their lives due to the attack.

Less than a decade later, a year ago today, my alma mater endured another act of violence where two lives were lost, six were injured, and a whole community was left brokenhearted. Students were forced to hide while hearing their classmates cry out for help. No one should ever have to experience that—once, let alone twice.
